subject: Life Skills

source.topic: Personal and Social Well-being: People who help us
source.subtopic: The scholar patrol and the role they play in safety; how traffic officers help us; the work of a traffic officer

show.line: Scholar patrols and traffic officers help us cross roads safely!

rounds.prompt: Who helps children cross outside school?
The scholar patrol holds up a stop sign. What do cars do?

rounds.story: A traffic officer waves cars to stop. Children cross. Who keeps them safe?

hints: Think of uniforms and where they work.
These helpers keep our roads safe.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! The scholar patrol says stop.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Cars must stop.

parent_line: Knows how scholar patrols, traffic officers and other helpers keep us safe.
